improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
improve.coach: 47% of matches overall, down to 20% recently. Keep chipping away.

improve.title: Shot selection
tips: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is.
Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.
improve.coach: It's come up in 33% of your matches, but only 20% lately. You're winning this one.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling. There in 60% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: Getting shots off
strengths.coach: You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota. 60% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Goal threat
